tagline.en: A web chat interface plus a local LLM server, CPU-only by default (NVIDIA/AMD GPU options are documented)
tagline.pt: Interface de chat web + servidor de LLMs locais, CPU-only por padrão (opções de GPU NVIDIA/AMD documentadas)

notes.en:
Open `http://<host-ip>:3003` or `https://ollama.<your-tailnet>.ts.net`.

### Web search

With [SearXNG](../searxng) running, the model can answer from pages fetched at
the time of the question. Uncomment the three lines in
`~/.config/containers/env/openwebui.env` and run `qh openwebui --update
--apply`:

```ini
ENABLE_RAG_WEB_SEARCH=True
RAG_WEB_SEARCH_ENGINE=searxng
SEARXNG_QUERY_URL=http://searxng:8080/search?q=<query>
```

Both containers are on `tsdproxy-net`, so `searxng` resolves by name.
notes.pt:
Abrir `http://<ip-do-host>:3003` ou `https://ollama.<your-tailnet>.ts.net`.

### Busca web

Com o SearXNG rodando, o modelo passa a responder
a partir de páginas buscadas na hora da pergunta. Descomente as três linhas do
`~/.config/containers/env/openwebui.env` e rode `qh openwebui --update
--apply`:

```ini
ENABLE_RAG_WEB_SEARCH=True
RAG_WEB_SEARCH_ENGINE=searxng
SEARXNG_QUERY_URL=http://searxng:8080/search?q=<query>
```

Os dois containers estão na `tsdproxy-net`, então `searxng` resolve pelo nome.
